title: Oro Climbs Higher, Park Construction Advances at Mississauga's Edge Towers
summary: Work at Oro condominiums at Hurontario Street and Elm Drive West in Mississauga’s Fairview neighbourhood has climbed from its podium to its tower floors, while park construction is progressing at the west end of the site beside the completed Edge Towers. Designed by Rosario “Roy” Varacalli for Solmar Development Corp, the 50-storey condominium is the community's third and tallest phase.
